description: Shelf Liners cushion and protect your surfaces and home goods from everyday wear and tear. Our selection of colors and designs will add style and freshen up your shelves, drawers and closets.
Includes Bonded Grip Shelf Liner. For covering shelves, cabinets, closets, drawers, arts & crafts.
Easy to cut and apply with no adhesive to get in the way of application. Washable and wipes clean w/ a damp cloth.
Roll Size: 12 Inches x 10 Feet Color: Multicolor Selections Material: Durable and Washable Material Design: Non-Slip and Non-Adhesive
